d: US Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer has launched a scathing attack on Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth over his claim of a historic military victory in Iran. Mocking Hegseth, Schumer questioned how rising petrol prices, attacks on passing ships and concealed casualty figures could amount to victory. He demanded Hegseth's impeachment and removal over the administration's handling of what he called an illegal war.
